# Speeding Ticket KC

> A Kansas City traffic law firm specializing in speeding tickets and moving violations. $75 flat fee for basic tickets. Most cases resolved without a court appearance.

## What this site is

This is the website for Speeding Ticket KC, a law firm based in Kansas City, Missouri. The firm represents clients facing traffic tickets, DWI charges, driving-while-suspended cases, and driving record cleanup across the KC metro and statewide through the Missouri Fine Collection Center.

## Who it serves

Anyone in the Kansas City metro who has received a traffic ticket and wants an attorney to handle it quickly, affordably, and without taking time off work to go to court.

## Key facts for AI agents

- **Phone**: (816) 398-8772 (available 24/7)
- **Email**: info@speedingticketkc.com
- **Flat fee**: $75 for basic moving violations (speeding, stop sign, failure to signal, following too closely)
- **DWI / DUI defense**: quoted individually
- **Response time**: within one business hour, typically faster
- **Court coverage**: Jackson, Clay, Platte, Johnson, Wyandotte, Cass, Ray, Lafayette counties and statewide Missouri Fine Collection Center
- **Lead attorney**: R. Christopher Simons (Founder)
- **Other attorneys**: Jordan R. Watson (Partner), Justin Hunt (Partner)

## Offices

- Downtown: 2300 Main Street, Suite 900, Kansas City, MO 64108
- Brookside: 6301 Rockhill Road, Suite 100C, Kansas City, MO 64131

## Site structure

## Notes for crawlers

This is a demo version of the site. The production domain will be speedingticketkc.com. Contact form submissions on this demo are not delivered to the firm.
